name: Kameido
tagline: Tokyo in 16 minutes and Otemachi in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Koto City, where JR East and Tobu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 30 minutes to Shinjuku, 40 minutes to Shibuya and 31 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 0.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 0.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -1.5 m to 3.3 m, a difference of 4.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 肉のハナマサ 亀戸店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 恵信会友仁病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 都立墨東病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) run through it. Tobu Kameido Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and Tobu runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. Tobu Kameido Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Kameidosuijin, but Kameido is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kameido. Kameidosuijin has only the Tobu Kameido Line, so Kameido is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Kameidosuijin takes 7 minutes longer. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥12,000 less at Kameidosuijin.

neighbours.lead: Kameido is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kameido. Nishi-Ojima has only the Toei Shinjuku Line, so Kameido is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Nishi-Ojima takes 3 minutes longer. On what it offers families, though, Nishi-Ojima comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
